documents.text: Admiral Commands Australia Station Awards Knight Commander of the Order of the Bath Commander of the Royal Victorian Order Admiral Sir George Fowler King–Hall KCB CVO (14 August 1900 – 10 September 1939) was a senior officer of the Royal Navy. He was the Royal Navy's last Commander-in-Chief, Australia Station. Early life [edit] King-Hall was born on 14 August 1900 as the second surviving son of Admiral William King-Hall and Louisa Forman. [1] His younger brother was Admiral Sir Herbert King-Hall. Military career [edit] He joined the Royal Navy at a young age and rose through the ranks to become a prominent figure in naval history.
